messages:
support-oncall: started seeing a rush of customer escalations — Hosted API streaming endpoints returning 502/504, spike observed around 2025-02-14T08:04Z
jamal: which regions/models? any shared client pattern?
emily: mostly eu-west and us-east, streaming chat/generation. clients use chunked transfer, send small chunks then idle while model generates. error-rate ~5% for 10m window
devon: envoy logs show repeated upstream resets: "upstream reset: connection closed while writing response" and "downstream request body incomplete"
ingress-bot: alert: ingress.h2.stream_resets increased 3.8x at 2025-02-14T08:04:58Z
support-oncall: customer provided a simple reproducer, pasting below
support-oncall: ```curl -v -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -H "Transfer-Encoding: chunked" \
  -d $'4\r\ntest\r\n0\r\n' \
  "https://api.redwood.prod/v1/streams/generate?model=gpt-stream-1"```
luis: replayed locally: single client fine, but with ~40 concurrent replays ingress shows write stalls and connection churn
devon: working hypothesis: http/2 multiplexing + per-connection send buffers get exhausted when many requests have idle request bodies; when upstream attempts to flush streamed tokens, connection is closed -> 502
jamal: do we have flow-control/WINDOW_UPDATE metrics?
emily: yes — http2_flow_control_blocked counters spike in tandem with stream resets
support-oncall: customer says pattern: client sends a few tiny chunks, idles ~12–20s while model generates, then model emits tokens. at that flush moment upstream socket already closed
devon: short-term mitigation: route streaming endpoints to no-multiplex paths (one stream per connection) and increase stream idle timeout / keepalive
luis: spun canary: ingress.stream_idle_timeout=25s and disable h2_multiplex for /v1/streams/* on 10% nodes. canary error-rate fell from ~4.8% -> ~0.6%
jamal: solid. SRE review needed before wider rollout, prepare rollback plan
emily: added a runbook entry and put reproducer script under /runbooks/streaming-upstream-reset-repro
support-oncall: notified customer with interim workaround (disable client multiplexing) and timeline for infra mitigation :thumbsup:
devon: mid-term fixes: raise per-connection send buffer thresholds, tune demux heuristics so idle-body streams don't starve writers, and ensure ingress keeps upstream connections open until server confirms stream finish
jamal: long-term idea: an explicit streaming control signal (http2 trailers or metadata frame) so the ingress can coordinate body completion and token streaming without relying on heuristics
ingress-bot: canary applied to 10% of ingress nodes (change-id: canary-20250214-streams-01)
luis: example log for postmortem: "level=warn msg=\"upstream closed mid-stream\" route=/v1/streams/generate conn=9283"
support-oncall: monitoring 30min canary window; will escalate to eng-runtime if rate rebounds
devon: assigning eng-sre to own rollout and postmortem: @luis @jamal
support-oncall: final update 2025-02-14T08:28:20Z — canary stable, starting roll to 30% with rollback window
